proposed_widenings.name: ActivationPhase.unconditional
proposed_widenings.justification: Misty Step fires an effect on cast with no roll and no save gate. The activation family is the right family (one-shot, instant), but every ActivationPhase variant currently requires either attack_roll or save_gate. An unconditional phase — one that simply grants its effect on resolution — is needed for all spells that have no resolution gate.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

proposed_widenings.name: Effect.move
proposed_widenings.justification: Teleportation is positional displacement of the caster (or a target). The v4 atom inventory already includes 'move' and 'transport_exile', but the Effect union in types.ts only contains 'damage' and 'none'. A 'move' effect variant is needed to express unconditional positional displacement with a distance cap.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see

notes: Both gaps are surface_widening: the activation family exists and is the correct fit, but requires an unconditional phase variant; the v4 'move' atom exists but is absent from types.ts Effect. No dhall or json authored — the unit cannot be honestly encoded without both widenings.
